feeds.title: Saorsa Studio Blog
feeds.description: At Saorsa Studio, we offer highland dance classes for all ages and skill levels. From group lessons to 1:1 instruction, there's a movement class for everyone. In the blogs get the latest news on highland dance, including competitions, events, and more.

feeds.title: Rachel Blog » Highland Dance
feeds.description: Rachel Blog is a place where she writes about her life and updates whether it be outing or a day or anything. Explore the site and read posts about Highland Dance written by Rachel M to give you updates about it and some interesting facts to see.

feeds.title: Sophie Stephenson Blog
feeds.description: Sophie Stephenson is a dance artist, teacher, and performer from the Highlands of Scotland. Sophie specializes in a close-to-the-floor style of percussive step dance which has origins in Scotland This blog is for all things dance-related she posts videos, articles information, and news, making it a great way to keep up with what's going on in the step-dancing world!

feeds.title: Piedmont Highland Dance Blog
feeds.description: Here at Piedmont Highland Dance, we offer a well-rounded program that strives to increase overall fitness. In addition to learning the dances, at Piedmont Highland Dance we include periods of warm-up and warm-down as well as flexibility and strengthening exercises that are targeted to the movements of Highland Dance.

feeds.title: Highland Hustle
feeds.description: Highland Hustle is a unique Scottish dance-based workout with a feel-good factor! Accessible, with ranges from beginner to advanced. Highland Hustle is designed for an adult like you. Designed to get more people dancing, and enjoying moves from Highland dance (whether you have danced before or not!) in a funky, fresh, and innovative way.

feeds.title: The Press And Journal » Highland Dancing
feeds.description: The Press and Journal have been the trusted voice of Scotland for generations. We continue to focus on local news and views, we bring them to life in new ways such as inspirational documentaries, engaging podcasts, and interactive in-depth explorations of the issues most relevant to readers' day-to-day lives. Our Highland dancing section of the website will you with the latest news and updates about dancing practices and artists, etc.

feeds.title: Highland Dance Shop Blog
feeds.description: The Highland Dance Shop aims to provide highland dance products for every type of Highland Dancer out there -competitive, display, or hobby. In the blogs read amazing informative articles by Sharon McDowell at Highland Dance Shop which is there to help you stay updated.
